name: Steve Padilla

items.text: While Chula Vista's mayor, Padilla had a personal bodyguard paid by the city, at a base pay of $10,000 a month. Critics objected during his 2006 re-election bid, which he lost. In 2014 he said he hired the bodyguard after anonymous threats. He said it was cheaper than using police, and he called it a mistake.
items.why: Padilla admits using city money for a bodyguard, but I found no official finding of abuse of office or self-dealing (criterion 6), so it is shown without counting.

for_review: I could not read the original 2006 San Diego Union-Tribune or Chula Vista Star-News reporting. The Star-News archive page was blocked. The only 2006-era coverage I found was a partisan blog (flashreport.org) that mentions a requested fraud investigation and the council reinstating the contract. I did not use it. Someone should check whether any investigation or finding followed. Also check whether the paycheck advances the 2014 Star News mentioned (10 advances, 2 of them double) were reported or reviewed by officials. Padilla said they broke no rules. The owner-sites search found nothing relevant to Padilla.
